title: NRA Headquarters Range
specs: Located at NRA Headquarters in Fairfax, VA
Offers pistol, rifle (.460 Weatherby Mag), and shotgun (slugs only) shooting
Complete a short safety test and briefing to receive a Range Card
All shooters must complete required paperwork and present valid photo ID
Minimum age 7 years old and able to comprehend written range rules
Shooters under 18 must be accompanied by parent or legal guardian on first visit
No firearm rentals; bring your own firearms or come with someone who owns them
Only semi-auto fire permitted during public hours
Family memberships available for spouses and children living at the same address
includes: Range Safety Officers on site to monitor safety and answer questions
Rifle benches, chairs, and rifle rests available
blurb: The NRA Range offers shooting activities for pistols, rifles, and shotguns with slugs only. Guests must provide their own firearms and complete a safety test and briefing to receive a Range Card. The range operates on a first come, first served basis with hourly lane rentals and annual membership options.
extraNote: No reservations; lanes assigned on first come, first served basis · Mandatory one-time $10 fee for safety test and briefing for first time shooters · Range ID Card is valid indefinitely · Range may close or change hours for events, trainings, and competitions · NRA Headquarters parking garage rear entrance, walk down ramp to NRA Range front desk.
